headline: Four Points Technology, LLC is teamed with Leidos on NASA NEST Contract
summary:
WASHINGTON, Sept.  13, 2019  (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Four Points Technology, LLC has partnered with Leidos (NYSE:LDOS) on their awarded NASA End-User Services & Technologies (NEST) contract.

NASA’s End-User Services & Technologies (NEST) contract is a single award, firm-fixed-price, indefinite delivery/indefinite quantity contract estimated in value of $2.9B if all options are exercised. Work will be performed at ten (10) NASA centers nationwide.
